name: sgs/buybox
title: Buybox
description: WooCommerce single-product PDP area: renders the full product hero (gallery column + configurator column) as a responsive 2-column CSS Grid. Gallery column shows the variation-aware image gallery (main image + thumbnail strip, driven by the sgs/product-card Interactivity store). Configurator column renders per-axis option-picker pills, live price row, comparative value ladder, stock status, back-in-stock notify form, and an accessible add-to-cart form. Falls back to core WC blocks for simple products or when WooCommerce is absent.

sgs._comment_mediaElements: Two independently-scoped media elements: 'main' is the gallery-col.php .product-card__media .product-card-img (the large PDP display image); 'thumb' is the .product-card__thumb img thumbnail-rail image (a distinct role — a small selectable preview, not the same image rendered twice). Mirrors sgs/before-after's before/after prefix pattern so a client can set a different fit for each.

wrapper.label: Buybox wrapper
wrapper._note: supports.color is explicitly {background:false,text:false} and spacing.padding is false — this thin composer block carries no paint/typography surface of its own (it composes sgs/product-card + sgs/option-picker, which own their own styling). layout is scoped to margin only; every other layout member is an honest gap.

rrp-pill.label: RRP saving pill
rrp-pill._note: FR-Wave-B. SSR-only chip shown when a configured RRP meta key resolves to a genuine saving on the default variation (includes/product-rrp.php::sgs_product_rrp_saving). Background/text colour both live here rather than on the wrapper element, since this is a distinct visual element from the price row it sits beside.

stock-in-stock.label: In-stock label
stock-in-stock._note: FR-Wave-B. Shown only when showStockStatus is on. Colours both the label text and the status dot (extras.php::sgs_buybox_extras_scoped_css). Split into three separate elements (in/low/out) because each is its own css:color target — one element manifest entry cannot map three attributes to the same css_property key.

stock-low-stock.label: Low-stock label
stock-low-stock._note: FR-Wave-B. See stock-in-stock note — same mechanism, the low-stock state (WooCommerce per-variation stock management, extras.php::sgs_buybox_stock_status).

stock-out-of-stock.label: Out-of-stock label
stock-out-of-stock._note: FR-Wave-B. See stock-in-stock note — same mechanism, the out-of-stock state.

fx._comment_providesNatively: Spec 38 FR-38-13. This block's horizontal scroller is `.product-card__thumbs`, a DESCENDANT, while the generic 'Scroll & effects' picker stamps data-sgs-fx onto the block ROOT — so a picker entry here would be a control that silently does nothing. The CSS-derived `track` provision (2026-07-31) correctly sees the scroller and would otherwise offer it. Declared here to suppress that entry. Own drag toggle SHIPPED 2026-07-31 (register Step 3): `dragToScroll`/`dragMomentum` attrs below, mirroring sgs/gallery + sgs/post-grid + sgs/google-reviews. Proven on a product-page fixture (product 541/540 variation gallery expanded to 10 images so the 64px-thumb strip genuinely overflows its ~644px column at 1440px) BEFORE this attr existed: scrollWidth 712 > clientWidth 644, confirming the scroller is real. The toggle itself ships unverified live in THIS session — it needs a build + deploy this session did not run (constrained to no-deploy) — so re-run the same fixture after deploy and confirm cursor:grab + data-sgs-fx="draggable" appear before treating the capability as proven end-to-end.

soldOutLabel.description: Aria-label suffix appended to pill labels when a combination is sold out. Shown to screen readers only.

unavailableLabel.description: Aria-label suffix appended to pill labels when a combination does not exist for the current selections.

notifyEnabled.description: Show the 'notify me when back in stock' email-capture form on out-of-stock variations.

notifyMeLabel.description: Heading/label for the back-in-stock notify-me form.

addToCartLabel.description: Override the Add to Cart button label. Empty = use the default translated string.

addToCartAction.description: 'cart' adds the selected variation to the cart directly (default). 'modal' opens an sgs/modal instead — used when the modal holds a choice-flow that asks further questions and finishes the purchase (Spec 43 Phase 3/4).

addToCartModalId.description: The HTML anchor set on the sgs/modal block this button opens, when addToCartAction is 'modal'. Empty falls back to cart mode even when 'modal' is selected.

perUnitDenomination.description: Override the per-unit denomination template. Use %s as the placeholder for the unit label (e.g. 'per bar', 'per 100g'). Empty = translated default 'per %s'.

showLadder.description: Show the comparative value-ladder table. Set false to suppress it (e.g. in narrow sidebar contexts).

framingMode.description: Saving-label framing: 'savings' (positive), 'loss-aversion' (adds 'vs buying singly' tail), or 'neutral' (no saving label).

decoyEnabled.description: When true, the 'Best value' badge targets the 2nd-largest pack (decoy effect) instead of the largest.

dragToScroll.description: Lets desktop shoppers click and drag the thumbnail strip, on top of its native scroll/swipe. Spec 38 FR-38-13.

dragMomentum.description: When drag-to-scroll is on, keep coasting briefly after release like a real scroll flick.

loopCarousel.description: Scrolling or dragging the thumbnail strip past the last image continues into the first, and back again — never a dead end. Independent of drag-to-scroll; combinable or standalone. Spec 38 §11 loop FR.

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColour.

stickyEnabled.description: Keep the configurator column (price, pickers, add-to-cart) pinned in view while the shopper scrolls a long product description below it. Off by default. Disabled below 768px regardless of this setting — a stuck column on a phone-width screen fights the shopper's scroll.

stickyOffset.description: Extra CSS length (e.g. "12px", "1rem") between the sticky column and the sticky header, on top of the header's own live height. Empty = flush against the header.

stackBelow.description: Where the gallery and configurator sit side by side: 'mobile' = from 768px up (stacked on phones), 'tablet' = from 1024px up (stacked on phones and tablets).

rrpMetaKey.description: Post-meta key holding the recommended retail price (a plain number in the shop's major currency unit, e.g. "171.00"). Empty = the saving pill is off. Set per-site to whatever meta key stores RRP for that catalogue.

rrpSavingFormat.description: How the saving pill is worded: a money amount ("Save £32") or a percentage ("Save 19%").

showStockStatus.description: Replace the plain out-of-stock line with an always-visible in-stock / low-stock / out-of-stock indicator (coloured dot + label). Off keeps today's behaviour (a line shown only when out of stock). Reflects the initially-selected variation only — it does not update if the shopper swaps to a different combination.

extrasBeforeCount.description: How many of the extras slot's first child blocks render at the top of the configurator column, above the price. The rest stay below the add-to-cart form. 0 = all below, the current behaviour.

extrasBeforeCartCount.description: After the extrasBeforeCount children (above the price), how many of the NEXT extras-slot children render between the pickers/stock status and the add-to-cart form. The rest stay below the form. 0 = none, the current behaviour.

pickerSwatchStyle.description: Pill style forwarded to an option-picker axis whose terms carry a colour or image swatch (e.g. Colour), detected via each term's _sgs_swatch_color/_sgs_swatch_image_id meta. Empty = that picker's own default.

pickerStyle.description: Pill style forwarded to every other option-picker axis (no colour/image swatch, e.g. Size). Empty = that picker's own default.

pickerSubLabelMetaKey.description: Term-meta key forwarded to every option picker as its subLabelMetaKey — a second caption line under each option (e.g. a frame size's eye/bridge/temple measurement). Empty = no second line.

pickerShowSelectedTick.description: Forwarded to every option picker's showSelectedTick.

priceFontFamily.description: Font family for the current-price element, sourced from theme.json's typography.fontFamilies preset list via the shared TypographyControls font-family picker. Empty = inherit the theme's default (body) font.

rrpShowPrice.description: When the RRP saving applies, also show "RRP <amount>" in the price row with the amount struck through (plus a visually-hidden "Recommended retail price" label for screen readers).

rrpSavingPrefix.description: The words before the amount in the RRP saving pill, e.g. "You save" gives "You save £32". Also used with the percentage format ("You save 19%").

addToCartStyle.description: Add-to-cart button style preset (matches the SGS button presets). Empty = today's accent-colour look.

addToCartShowPrice.description: Show the current price at the right end of the add-to-cart button (label on the left, price on the right).

stockInStockLabel.description: Replaces the in-stock label text only (e.g. "In stock — dispatched next working day"). Empty = WooCommerce's own availability text. Low-stock and out-of-stock wording are unchanged.
